semantics: BoundPolicy checks the original detached view and budget, not callback-mutated copies.
Pause requires no active execution and exact integer zero active reservations; the ledger repeats its active-reservation check under its writer transaction.
The existing decision table records Pause, but stop_json is never cleared or set by it. Existing operator/terminal/storage Stop remains sticky.
The foreground invocation exits while preserving queued work, resource scope, reservations and accumulated charges. A later invocation re-evaluates actual state.
This is not a global peer-admission ban or a scientific completion judgment.
real_installed_cli_validation: Required separately; unit tests do not stand in for an installed continuous/Pause workflow.
